name: Add registration input validation and error messages
description: Implement validateRegistration in src/registration.ts checking username, email, password, and age with detailed error messages.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement validateRegistration(input: any) in src/registration.ts. Validate: 1) username: 3-20 chars alphanumeric + underscores only ('Username must be 3-20 alphanumeric characters'), 2) email: valid format with @ and . ('Invalid email address format'), 3) password: >= 8 chars with at least one number and one special character !@#$%^&* ('Password must be at least 8 characters with at least one number and special character'), 4) age: if provided, must be >= 13 ('User must be at least 13 years old'). Return { valid: boolean, errors: string[] }. All tests in test/registration.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: Returns valid: true and empty errors on valid input
Collects all relevant error messages on invalid input
Handles missing fields without throwing unhandled exceptions
